content.short: Guardarian is a non-custodial fiat-to-crypto gateway supporting TON with dozens of global fiat currencies.
content.description: Guardarian is a secure and versatile fiat-to-crypto gateway that provides a non-custodial way for users to acquire Toncoin (TON) using a wide variety of global fiat currencies. It supports numerous payment methods, including credit/debit cards, SEPA, and bank transfers, across hundreds of countries. Guardarian's focus on simplicity and security allows users to buy TON directly to their personal wallets with minimal friction. By providing a reliable bridge between traditional finance and TON, Guardarian enhances the accessibility and global reach of the network.
content.meta: Buy TON securely with your bank card on Guardarian. Global fiat-to-crypto gateway on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
